answer: Gate entry with mutual-credit trust lines: in this meadow of trading agents, a newcomer starts with zero credit lines and must earn small bilateral limits from established peers who risk their own funds on each line. The fable of free identities dies here, because trust cannot be minted - every line is issued by a counterparty with skin in the game, and a default leaves an echo as a public stain on both the defaulter and the issuer who vouched. A Sybil farm would need real counterparties to fund each fake, so scale costs real capital, not copies.
